external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who are vouched for by their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: own devices
external_entities.description: Devices used by colleagues to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise stores
external_entities.description: Franchise organisations whose colleagues are admitted to the system.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by franchise colleagues' organisation that vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system providing overnight changes to group membership and leaver status.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-ins, and supplies public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: Colleague sign-in credentials and identity information

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and groups

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague uses a token to invoke price changes and transaction voids at the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: Authorization token and price or transaction changes

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider receives or verifies a franchise colleague's sign-in and vouches for them.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
data_flows.data_description: Franchise colleague identity information

data_flows.name: federated sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.data_description: A franchise colleague's sign-in assertion

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker uses the signing key kept in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: Signing key

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains colleague and group information in its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleague records and group memberships

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls overnight group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Group membership changes and leaver status

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public signing key from the identity broker to validate token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the token-signing key

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own devices at home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled zone from which franchise colleagues are admitted.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's data is confidential because it contains colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's data is confidential because sign-in records identify or describe colleagues' authentication activity.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's data is confidential because it holds a signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store contains the broker's signing key.
